title: LIMITED-TIME EVENT: #04 TRIALS FOR NAVIGATOR OPEN
lines: 01 LIMITED-TIME EVENT: #04 TRIALS FOR NAVIGATOR OPEN

DETAILS: Trials for Navigator will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing Trial Tasks for Trial EXP, and increasing the level of Path of Trials.
[Path of Trials] REWARDS: 0011 Collection Outfit - Yearly Present for Purestream, Headhunting Permit, Module Materials, Elite Materials, Battle Records, LMD, Furniture Part, etc.
02 TARGETED OPERATOR HEADHUNTING OPEN: JOINT OPERATION
DETAILS: During the event, the Targeted Operator Headhunting, [Joint Operation], opens and ONLY the following Operators will appear in the 6★ and 5★ Operator List of this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★: Andreana / Blacknight / Lunacub / Akafuyu / Ashlock / Melanite
03 EPOQUE COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfit will be available at the Outfit Store:
EPOQUE Collection - Paper Wing for Enforcer
Please stay tuned for more information!
